description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Attach Wind 3 with Stacking], [Terra Trance], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Terra (Wind)]

description.name: Zenith Mode: Terra (Wind)
description.text: Increases [Wind Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Terra (Wind) after using a Wind ability (max 3), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Terra (Wind)
description.text: 5/10/15 single attacks (1.50 each) after 1/2/3 uses, grants [Quick ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Terra Trance
description.text: ATK, DEF, MAG, RES, MND, ACC and EVA +20%, cast speed x2.00

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
